meta.disclaimer: Four separate ledgers, not one flow. Each band is sized to its own dollar total on one shared scale. The ledgers cover different scopes and time windows, so no band is a share of the one above it, and the four are never added together.
meta.units: dollars, nominal, rounded to the dollar where the owning file rounds

lanes.name: Committed
lanes.scope: Full City capital plan: unspent budget of active projects, one record per agency and FMS ID, close-out excluded
lanes.window: stock at the 202605 capital plan period

lanes.name: Awarded
lanes.scope: City Record construction award notices, one record per PIN at its largest amount; renewals, extensions and $500M+ awards included
lanes.source: NYC City Record qyyg-4tf5 via data/precomputed.json

lanes.name: Registered
lanes.scope: Sum of current registered amounts, registered construction expense contracts to named vendors, City scope
lanes.window: contracts Checkbook lists under FY21–26 + FY27 YTD
lanes.split_note: No agency split is published for this ledger.

lanes.name: Paid
lanes.scope: Cumulative paid to date on the same registered contracts
lanes.window: lifetime of the contracts listed under FY21–26 + FY27 YTD, as of the file date
lanes.split_note: No agency split is published for this ledger.
